integrity: Separate exact finite computations corroborate rank identities, but only the supplied proof establishes the infinite asymptotic; no claim of exhaustive priority or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed arity \(k\ge2\) and fixed \(q=2^s\) with \(s\ge1\), with labelled colors forming the elementary abelian 2-group. Counts are for automorphisms preserving the named colors; no uniform estimate for growing k or q. The \(q=2,k=2\) unlabeled two-graph enumeration is classical and is credited. A related older cohomological-hypergraph paper was not available in full; priority remains provisional. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp nonrigidity rate of finite even hypergraph extensions
